name: Headquarters
description: Command centre. Trains every unit type, earns a little money and feeds the abstract war along the front. Lose all your HQs and you are out.

name: Power Plant
description: Generates energy. Every other building draws on it; when the grid runs dry, production drops to 40%.

name: Housing Block
description: Citizens pay taxes (money) and enlist (people). People are spent on infantry and trenches.

name: Ore Mine
description: Extracts raw ore for the metal works. Uses energy.

name: Metal Works
description: Smelts ore into metal, needed for tanks, artillery, bunkers and most war buildings. Uses ore and energy.

name: Fuel Depot
description: Produces fuel for tanks and drones. Uses energy.

name: Rail Hub
description: Logistics hub: every friendly building within 25 km produces 25% more. Uses energy.

name: Trench Line
description: Cheap fortification. Friendly units and buildings within 6 km take less damage and the front is harder to push there.

name: Bunker
description: Hardened position: strong damage reduction and front resistance within 8 km.

name: Signal Station
description: Radio and recon post. Reveals enemy units and buildings within 35 km through the fog of war. Uses energy.

name: Pontoon Crossing
description: Boats and pontoons on a river bank. Your ground units can cross the river within 6 km. Without it rivers are crossed only on road bridges.

name: Anti-Air Station
description: Shoots down enemy drones and aircraft within 14 km. Ground weapons do little damage to air targets. Uses energy.

name: Training Centre
description: Send ground units inside (select them, right click the centre). With at least 3 inside you can pay for a course: after the wait they come out one rank higher and at full strength. Holds 12.
